versions.content: PortGroup s have to be defined on the VFB level Though the declaration PortGroup s is not relevant for the RTE, they have to be defined on the VFB level, because they represent design decisions taken on this level. Accordingly, PortGroup s can be defined for CompositionSwComponentType s as well as for AtomicSwComponentType s.
